These dependencies work the same way in WebSocket endpoints as in other FastAPI endpoints
`app.dependency_overrides` works during testing
`app.dependency_overrides[get_settings] = get_settings_override` can be used with `TestClient` to override dependencies during tests
`app.dependency_overrides` is the mechanism for overriding dependencies during testing with `TestClient`
`app.dependency_overrides` would apply when testing WebSocket endpoints with `TestClient`
